subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “A good warning system uses many paths.”?
options: In danger, the best message is the one that actually reaches the person who needs it.
It had also carried a simple message from one person to another: help does not have to stop with the person who receives it.
The boxes could not solve loneliness, but they could carry a message: someone remembered you today.
The hospital learned that technology works best when it gives humans more time to be human.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「A good warning system uses many paths. In danger, the best message is the one that actually reaches the person who needs…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「It had also carried a simple message from one person to another: help does not have to stop…」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The boxes could not solve loneliness, but they could carry a message: someone remembered you today.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The hospital learned that technology works best when it gives humans more time to be human.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「A good warning system uses many paths. In danger, the best message is the one that actually reaches the person who needs it.」，答案為「In danger, the best message is the one that actually reaches the person who needs it.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「In danger, the best message is the one that actually reaches the person who needs it.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
